### ✨ New Features

* **alerts bar:** Show the distance under each report, larger icons ([10ed464](https://github.com/DutchPharaoh/De-Waze-Patches/commit/10ed464cf75ffc72cf7e953f21126f1047629bd9))

patches.name: Alerts bar in Android Auto
patches.description: Shows a vertical bar on the right of the Android Auto map with the reports on your route in the next 10 km: speed cameras, police, accidents, jams, hazards and closures.

patches.name: Favorites on map
patches.description: Always shows your favorites as stars with their name on the map, on the phone and in Android Auto, also when not navigating.
